CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_user_in_group(gid uuid, uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.group_members
    where group_id = gid
      and user_id  = uid
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_default_family_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select id from families order by created_at asc limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_family_member(f uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.family_members
    where family_id = f
      and user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.on_profiles_insert_create_family()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.ensure_family_for_user(NEW.id, coalesce(NEW.display_name, 'My Family'));
  return NEW;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_member(u uuid, gid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.group_members gm
    where gm.user_id = u
      and gm.group_id = gid
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_group_member(gid uuid, uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.group_members gm
    where gm.group_id = gid and gm.user_id = uid
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_group_owner(gid uuid, uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.groups g
    where g.id = gid and g.owner_user_id = uid
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_group_admin_or_owner(gid uuid, uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    exists (
      select 1 from public.group_members gm
      where gm.group_id = gid
        and gm.user_id  = uid
        and gm.role in ('owner','admin')
    )
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.groups g
      where g.id = gid and g.owner_user_id = uid
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_family_for_user(uid uuid, family_name text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_family_id uuid;
  v_name text := coalesce(family_name, 'Family ' || left(uid::text, 8));
begin
  -- reuse existing family if present
  select fm.family_id
    into v_family_id
    from public.family_members fm
   where fm.user_id = uid
   limit 1;

  if v_family_id is null then
    insert into public.families (name)
    values (v_name)
    returning id into v_family_id;

    insert into public.family_members (family_id, user_id, role)
    values (v_family_id, uid, 'owner')
    on conflict do nothing;
  end if;

  return v_family_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end $function$
